decks.notes: This deck focuses on using efficient mana ramp cards like Arbor Elf, Utopia Sprawl, and Wild Growth to quickly play powerful creatures like Annoyed Altisaur, Avenging Hunter, and Boarding Party. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures while disrupting their mana base with cards like Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Stone Rain. Lightning Bolt provides additional removal and reach, while Jewel Thief can generate card advantage. The inclusion of Snow-Covered Lands allows for additional synergies with cards like Sarulf's Packmate and Thermokarst for added flexibility and control.

This deck focuses on assembling the Urzatron land combo to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It uses cards like Expedition Map and Ancient Stirrings to search for the Urza lands, while also utilizing artifacts like Chromatic Sphere and Chromatic Star to help with mana fixing. The deck maintains control through cards like Deadly Dispute and Makeshift Munitions, while also having ways to gain life and draw cards with Fangren Marauder and Ichor Wellspring. Ultimately, the goal is to pilot the deck to victory by overwhelming the opponent with a combination of mana advantage and control elements.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively deal damage to the opponent using low-cost spells and creatures. By utilizing a mix of direct damage spells and life-gain effects, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while also keeping the player's life total healthy. The creature base consists of evasive threats that can quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of damage while using efficient removal spells to control the board.

The main concept of this deck is to establish control over the game by utilizing the Urzatron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana. The deck focuses on card advantage, recursion, and protection spells to maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Mulldrifter, Mystical Teachings, and Ghostly Flicker, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and ultimately win the game through overwhelming card advantage and efficient use of resources.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize walls to generate mana and protect yourself while setting up a powerful combo to overwhelm your opponent. By using cards like Axebane Guardian, Overgrown Battlement, and Tinder Wall to ramp up your mana, you can quickly bring out powerful creatures like Annoyed Altisaur and Goliath Paladin. Lead the Stampede and Winding Way can help you dig for the pieces you need to assemble your combo, while cards like Avenging Hunter provide additional pressure on your opponent. Overall, this deck aims to create a strong board presence and overwhelm your opponent with a powerful combo.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's board through counterspells and removal spells, while also gaining value through cards like Mulldrifter and Archaeomancer. Ephemerate is a key card in this strategy, allowing for additional value from creatures with enters-the-battlefield effects. The deck also includes some flicker effects to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support the control aspect of the deck, with a mix of Islands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combo strategy with Goblins in order to quickly assemble powerful synergies and overwhelm the opponent. By combining cards like Skirk Prospector, Putrid Goblin, and Makeshift Munitions, the deck aims to generate a strong board presence and deal massive amounts of damage in a short amount of time. Additionally, the deck includes various cards for card draw and removal to ensure consistency and flexibility in executing its game plan.

The main concept of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and removal spells while draining their life total with cards like Gray Merchant of Asphodel. The deck includes a mix of disruptive creatures like Chittering Rats and Cuombajj Witches, along with removal spells like Cast Down and Defile to control the board. The deck also includes card draw and recursion with Phyrexian Rager and Unearth to maintain a steady stream of threats. The goal is to apply constant pressure and drain the opponent's life total until victory is achieved.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient burn spells. It aims to control the board with counterspells and disruption, while also drawing cards and manipulating the top of the deck to maximize damage output. Thermo-Alchemist and Kessig Flamebreather provide consistent damage, while Delver of Secrets and Tandem Lookout offer additional threats and card advantage. The deck's mana base allows for consistent access to both red and blue mana sources, ensuring a smooth curve and the ability to cast all spells in the deck efficiently.

This Mono Black Aggro deck focuses on controlling the board with efficient removal spells like Defile and Victim of Night while draining the opponent's life total with Gray Merchant of Asphodel and Pestilence effects. The deck utilizes creature like Gurmag Angler and Phyrexian Rager to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Cuombajj Witches and Chittering Rats. The deck aims to maintain card advantage with Sign in Blood and close out the game quickly with aggressive creatures and life drain effects.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering their spells, removing their threats, and gaining card advantage through draw spells. By controlling the board and outvaluing the opponent, the deck aims to stabilize the game and eventually win through efficient creatures like Gurmag Angler and Delver of Secrets. The mana base is designed to provide consistency and flexibility in casting spells, while the inclusion of snow-covered lands enables synergies with certain cards in the deck.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to power up early aggression and overwhelm opponents with efficient creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cheap artifacts and affinity synergies, the deck is able to quickly deploy threats and deal damage while also having tools for disruption and card advantage. The inclusion of sacrifice outlets like Makeshift Munitions and Deadly Dispute adds flexibility to the deck's game plan, allowing for different angles of attack and resource management. The deck aims to close out games quickly through a combination of creature beats and direct damage.

The main focus of this Pauper 1 vs 1 Control - Urzatron deck is to assemble the Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower to generate a large amount of mana, allowing for powerful plays and controlling the game. With cards like Expedition Map and Tocasia's Dig Site to search for the Urzatron pieces, along with creatures like Mine Worker and Tower Worker to help ramp up mana production, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with high-cost threats like Maelstrom Colossus and Wretched Gryff while maintaining control with cards like Staunch Throneguard and Self-Assembler.

The main focus of this Orzhov Aggro deck is to quickly and efficiently control the battlefield while applying pressure to the opponent through a mix of removal spells and aggressive creatures. Utilizing cards like Diabolic Edict and Cast Down to eliminate threats, while also deploying creatures like Vampire Sovereign and Goliath Paladin to deal damage and maintain board presence. The deck also includes cards like Ephemerate and Custodi Squire for added value and protection. Additionally, the deck utilizes bounce lands like Orzhov Basilica for mana efficiency and consistency.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game using the Urzatron lands while generating card advantage through recurring artifacts. The deck utilizes cards like Ashnod's Altar, Chromatic Star, and Ichor Wellspring to constantly fuel its card draw and artifact reanimation engine. It also includes cards like Deadly Dispute and Reckoner's Bargain to disrupt opponents and gain advantage through sacrificing artifacts. The goal is to outvalue the opponent over time and win the game with the help of Golem Foundry or other win conditions.

The main focus of this Pauper 1 vs 1 Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of counter spells, removal, and card draw. By controlling the board with cards like Counterspell and Cast Down, while also digging for key cards with Brainstorm and Deep Analysis, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win the game with powerful finishers like Gurmag Angler. The inclusion of Snow-Covered Islands and Tolarian Terror allows for extra utility and flexibility in executing the control strategy effectively.
